color.note: A DevBrain theme over shadcn's neutral theme: same variable names, Tailwind v4 colours. Light is shadcn's light theme except the ring; dark keeps shadcn's values except where a usage note says DevBrain override. Status colours use the 700 step in light so they stay legible on white.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page, list, dialog and sheet ground. shadcn default.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Body text (15.7:1 dark). DevBrain dark override: shadcn uses neutral-50; the Figma screens use neutral-200 to soften long lists.

tokens.name: foreground-strong
tokens.usage: Titles and the names in rows (18:1 dark). DevBrain addition.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Card ground. DevBrain dark override: shadcn uses neutral-900; DevBrain cards are outlined on the page, not filled.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `card`.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Popovers, dropdown/context/select menus, command palette, toasts. shadcn default.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `popover` (14.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Default (filled) button, checked checkbox and switch, selected calendar day, tooltip ground. shadcn default.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `primary`. shadcn default.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary button and badge. DevBrain dark override: shadcn uses neutral-800; Figma's filled controls are neutral-900.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `secondary`.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Tab-list track, group-heading band, avatar fallback, code. DevBrain dark override (shadcn neutral-800).

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text, placeholders, menu icons, descriptions. shadcn default (7.7:1 dark, 4.7:1 light).

tokens.name: subtle-foreground
tokens.usage: Dates, issue keys, previews: metadata a reader can skip. DevBrain addition; 4.2:1 in dark, so never for instructions or errors.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hover and keyboard highlight on menu items, rows, ghost buttons, toggles; skeletons. DevBrain dark override (shadcn neutral-800), matching Figma's hover.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `accent`.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Destructive buttons (filled), destructive menu items and invalid fields. shadcn default.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Default border: cards, popovers, menus, separators, rows. DevBrain dark override: shadcn uses white at 10%; Figma uses solid neutral-900.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Input, select, checkbox and outline-button borders; dark inputs are filled with it at 30%. DevBrain dark override (shadcn white at 15%).

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus: border turns `ring` plus a 3px `ring` halo at 50%. shadcn default in dark; light uses neutral-500 instead of neutral-400 for a clearer ring on white.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar ground. DevBrain dark override: shadcn uses neutral-900; the Figma sidebar sits on the page colour.

tokens.name: sidebar-foreground
tokens.usage: Sidebar item text and icons. DevBrain override (shadcn uses foreground); inactive items are quiet in Figma.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary
tokens.usage: Workspace tile when no colour is set. shadcn's sidebar-primary.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `sidebar-primary`.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent
tokens.usage: Active and hovered sidebar item. DevBrain dark override (shadcn neutral-800).

tokens.name: sidebar-accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Active sidebar item text.

tokens.name: sidebar-border
tokens.usage: Sidebar edge.

tokens.name: sidebar-ring
tokens.usage: Sidebar focus ring.

tokens.name: backdrop
tokens.usage: Scrim behind dialogs and sheets (shadcn bg-black/50).

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: Page and document titles (Home, Settings, a task, note or project). shadcn typography h2: text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight.

styles.name: heading-1
styles.usage: Note heading 1 and calendar day title. shadcn typography h3: text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Note heading 2. shadcn typography h4: text-xl font-semibold tracking-tight.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Note heading 3 (text-lg font-semibold; DevBrain addition, shadcn typography stops at h4).

styles.name: dialog-title
styles.usage: Dialog and alert dialog titles. shadcn: text-lg leading-none font-semibold.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Card and sheet titles, Home section headings. shadcn: leading-none font-semibold.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: You have 12 tasks and 4 meetings today.
styles.usage: Subtitle under a page title, in `muted-foreground`. shadcn typography lead: text-xl text-muted-foreground.

styles.name: paragraph
styles.sample: Replace the implicit-flow handoff with PKCE for all first-party clients.
styles.usage: Note and description body text. shadcn typography p: leading-7.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default UI text: menu items, inputs, table cells, task names in rows, sidebar items (text-sm).

styles.name: control
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, toggles, menu labels (text-sm font-medium).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels. shadcn Label: text-sm leading-none font-medium.

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: Badges and pills, sidebar group labels (text-xs font-medium).

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Dates, issue keys, tooltips, hints (text-xs), in `muted-foreground` or `subtle-foreground`.

styles.name: shortcut
styles.usage: Keyboard shortcuts in menus and command palette. shadcn: text-xs tracking-widest text-muted-foreground.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline code on `muted`. shadcn typography: font-mono text-sm font-semibold.

spacing.note: Tailwind's 0.25rem (4px) scale, as shadcn components use it.

tokens.name: space-0-5
tokens.usage: Badge vertical padding (py-0.5).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Menu and popover inner padding (p-1); badge gap.

tokens.name: space-1-5
tokens.usage: Menu item vertical padding (py-1.5); gap in small buttons and card headers.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Menu item horizontal padding (px-2); default gap (gap-2); sidebar group padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input and small-button horizontal padding (px-3).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default button padding (px-4); popover and sheet padding; row side padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Dialog and card padding (p-6); gap inside cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between Home sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top padding of document pages.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Side padding of document pages.

radius.note: shadcn's radius scale: everything derives from `radius` (0.625rem).

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: The base. Change this one value to make the whole system rounder or squarer.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Dialog close button, colour bars (rounded-xs).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Menu, select and command items (rounded-sm = radius - 4px).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, badges, toggles, popovers, menus, tooltips (rounded-md = radius - 2px).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, tab lists (rounded-lg = radius).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards (rounded-xl = radius + 4px).

tokens.name: radius-checkbox
tokens.usage: Checkbox (rounded-[4px]).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Switch, avatar, progress bar.

tokens.name: shadow-md

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, sheets, submenus, toasts.
